title: Can we push it?
setting: A phone call about dinner with Jordan. Jordan is stuck at work, so Maya and Chris have to move the time.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Hey, can we push it a little? Jordan just texted, they're stuck at work.
lines.spoken: Hey, can we push it a little? Jordan just texted, they're stuck at work.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Like, thirty minutes? Maybe forty? I don't know if we wait or just...
lines.spoken: Like, thirty minutes? Maybe forty? I dunno if we wait or just...

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: We can wait. Or we wanna start and they meet us?
lines.spoken: We can wait. Or we wanna start and they meet us?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I think they wanna come from the beginning. They said don't wait if it's annoying, but...
lines.spoken: I think they wanna come from the beginning. They said don't wait if it's annoying, but...

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: It's not annoying. Let's just say seven.
lines.spoken: It's not annoying. Let's just say seven.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Seven works for me. What time works for you, for real? Don't say seven if you were gonna be late anyway.
lines.spoken: Seven works for me. What time works for you, for real? Don't say seven if you were gonna be late anyway.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Seven is actually fine. I can leave a little later, even. That's better.
lines.spoken: Seven is actually fine. I can leave a little later, even. That's better.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Okay. I'll tell Jordan seven. If they can't do seven, we just do it tomorrow.
lines.spoken: Okay. I'll tell Jordan seven. If they can't do seven, we just do it tomorrow.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Yeah. I'm easy. Just text me.
lines.spoken: Yeah. I'm easy. Just text me.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I will. Thanks for not making this a thing.
lines.spoken: I will. Thanks for not making this a thing.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: It's plans. Plans move. I'll see you at seven.
lines.spoken: It's plans. Plans move. I'll see you at seven.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Seven. Don't leave your house at seven.
lines.spoken: Seven. Don't leave your house at seven.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I'm hanging up on you now.
lines.spoken: I'm hanging up on you now.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: That's fair. I'll send the new time in the group chat.
lines.spoken: That's fair. I'll send the new time in the group chat.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Do that. And if it moves again, tomorrow is fine. Really.
lines.spoken: Do that. And if it moves again, tomorrow is fine. Really.

gist.askEn: Why do they need to change the time?

gist.askZh: 他们最后暂定几点？如果还是不行怎么办？
gist.askEn: What time do they settle on, and what's the backup?
accept: do it tomorrow if Jordan can't

details.askZh: Maya 一开始说要推多久？
details.askEn: How much later did Maya first suggest?

details.askZh: Jordan 是想从头一起，还是中途再汇合？
details.askEn: Does Jordan want to arrive at the start, or join later?

glue.span: can we push it a little
glue.hear: can we push it a little
glue.noteZh: can we 都很弱，push it a little 才是请求本身；little 不是‘很小’，这里是‘稍微往后一点’。
glue.standard: can we push it a little

glue.noteZh: Let's just say 是做决定的口头禅，seven 才是时间；just say 不要听成 decide formally。
works for you 里 for 极弱，像 works fer you，问的是‘你真正方便的时间’。

chunks.form: Can we push it a little?
chunks.sayAfter: Can we push it a little? Jordan's stuck at work.
It's not annoying. Let's just say seven.
Seven works for me. What time works for you, for real?

roleplay.setupZh: 你们约了晚饭，第三个朋友还在加班。你要提议把时间往后推，给出一个具体时间，并准备好如果还是不行就改到明天。
roleplay.aiRole: Chris, flexible and slightly teasing ('don't leave your house at seven'). He is fine waiting or moving to tomorrow. He wants an honest time, not a polite one.
variants: They decide to start without Jordan after all.
mustUse: Can we push it a little
starters: Can we push it a little?

fluency.promptZh: 讲讲这次改时间：谁被卡住了，他们考虑过哪些方案，为什么定七点，如果还不行怎么办。准备 15 秒，然后 60、45、30 秒。
fluency.promptEn: Tell the reschedule: who got stuck, what options they considered, why they said seven, and what happens if that still doesn't work. Prep 15 seconds, then 60, 45, 30.
